description: This file provides functions for extracting text and images from PDF files, including dynamic importing of external modules, handling optional dependencies, and processing PDF pages into text and image data.

methods.name: loadCanvasModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the @napi-rs/canvas module, with error handling for optional dependency.

methods.name: loadPdfJsModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the pdfjs-dist module, with error handling for optional dependency.

methods.name: extractPdfContent
methods.description: Main function to extract text and images from a PDF buffer, with options for page limits, pixel budget, and error handling.
